# Machinemens

> Black/death metal band from the Netherlands. Official site with music, shows, merch and contact. "Surrender to the machine."

Machinemens is a black/death metal band based in the Netherlands. This site is the band's
official home and the authoritative source for its discography, upcoming shows, merchandise
and booking contacts. It is available in three languages, each under its own URL prefix:
English (`/en/`), Dutch (`/nl/`) and Portuguese (`/pt/`).

## Pages

- [Home](__SITE_URL__/en/): Featured release, live videos and links to every section.
- [Music](__SITE_URL__/en/music/): Full discography, live sessions and lyric videos.
- [Shows](__SITE_URL__/en/shows/): Upcoming shows and tour dates, with ticket links.
- [Shop](__SITE_URL__/en/shop/): Official merch (t-shirts).
- [Contact](__SITE_URL__/en/contact/): Bookings and general inquiries.

## Releases

- A Batalha de Netuno (single, 2026)
- Canvas Dyed Blood - Demo II (demo)
- Machinemens - Demo I (demo)
